faqs.question: Can I actually buy anything?
faqs.answer: Nope. Browse, cart, check out—nothing is really charged or shipped.

faqs.question: Where are the items in my cart stored?
faqs.answer: Only in the browser you're using right now. If you clear your browser data or switch devices, your cart may look different.

faqs.question: Will the pay button charge me?
faqs.answer: No. You get the checkout thrill and a very official-looking receipt.

faqs.question: Are the product photos and descriptions real listings?
faqs.answer: The photos come from Pexels. The names, prices, and descriptions were written for this fake store.

faqs.question: Do I get member benefits if I log in?
faqs.answer: You can pretend to log in, but no real account or reward points are created. Take the feeling of being rewarded instead.
